entries.description: Hardcore SWAT arcade shooter, Time Crisis style. One-hit deaths on hard mode, solo or co-op.
entries.name: Crisis VRigade

entries.description: Procedural roguelike shooter that uses redirected walking, so you keep walking through endless rooms inside your own play space.
entries.name: Tea for God

entries.description: Tactical multiplayer VR shooter, Counter-Strike style. The free SideQuest/App Lab beta is historic; the full game is now paid on the Horizon Store, check the current listing before installing.
entries.name: Pavlov Shack

entries.description: Short VR wildlife experience built in Unity for Quest 2. Sideload the 51 MB APK.
entries.name: Wildlife VR

entries.description: Indie VR game for Quest, sideload the 144 MB APK with SideQuest or any ADB installer.
entries.name: Chimp Paradox

entries.description: Game-jam VR game, free / pay what you want. Quest 1 and 2 sideload APK, v1.0.1.
entries.name: My Best Friends Are Giant Mushrooms (VR)

entries.description: VR dodgeball with random items. APK is hosted on an external drive link from the itch.io page, check the page before downloading.
entries.name: Wreck Room VR

entries.description: Short class-project VR experience. Sideload the APK zip onto Quest.
entries.name: Serenity

entries.description: Doom 3 running natively on Quest with 6DOF motion controls, by Team Beef. Needs your own Doom 3.
entries.name: Doom3Quest

entries.description: GZDoom/LZDoom engine on Quest with full 6DOF. Plays Doom, Doom II, Heretic, Hexen and community mods. Needs your own WADs.
entries.name: QuestZDoom

entries.description: The original Quake (1996) on Quest with 6DOF motion controls, DarkPlaces engine. Needs your own Quake.
entries.name: QuakeQuest

entries.description: Quake II on Quest, single-player campaign with 6DOF, HD weapons and the original soundtrack. Needs your own Quake II.
entries.name: Quake2Quest

entries.description: Quake III Arena on Quest with motion controls and online multiplayer. Needs your own Quake III Arena.
entries.name: Quake3Quest

entries.description: Half-Life 1 on Quest in VR, Xash3D engine port by Team Beef. Needs your own Half-Life on Steam.
entries.name: Lambda1VR (Half-Life)

entries.description: Return to Castle Wolfenstein on Quest. Needs your own Return to Castle Wolfenstein game files.
entries.name: RTCWQuest

entries.description: Star Wars Jedi Knight games on Quest and other OpenXR headsets. Needs your own Jedi Knight game files.
entries.name: JKXR (Jedi Knight)

entries.description: The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind in VR on Quest, OpenMW engine. No game files included, needs your own Morrowind (Steam or GOG). Tribunal and Bloodmoon are detected automatically.
entries.name: OpenMW VR (Morrowind)

entries.description: Morrowind in VR with multiplayer (TES3MP on OpenMW-VR), by Nikman17. Version 0.47.0-46 is already on the owner's Quest 2. Needs your own Morrowind data files.
entries.name: TES3MP VR Quest (Morrowind multiplayer)

entries.description: Minecraft: Java Edition on Quest, standalone, with Vivecraft VR controls. Needs a legal copy of Minecraft: Java Edition and internet for first setup. Do not use questcraft.net, it is not run by the team.
entries.name: QuestCraft (Minecraft)

entries.description: Free fork of Google's Tilt Brush, room-scale 3D painting in VR. Apache 2.0. Also on the owner's Quest 2, version 2.31.0.
entries.name: Open Brush

entries.description: Free VR video player for 180 and 360 video, local files and streaming. Free on SideQuest and the Horizon Store.
entries.name: DeoVR (VR Video Player)

entries.description: The reference sideloading store itself, as an in-headset app. Listed here as a source, not a replacement: the ReOculus app is the local-only alternative. Note SideQuest's newer setup needs a Meta account; ReOculus does not.
entries.name: SideQuest (in-headset app)

note: MOCK catalogue only. Every entry is free, legal to sideload, and needs no Meta account. Install is not wired up yet; this file is the source of truth for the list. Edit this file, then rebuild the mock page to pick up changes. Ports that need the original game do NOT include game data.
